# templateconnector-api — Architecture

> Current documentation index generated from the exact MkDocs navigation.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://knuckles-team.github.io/templateconnector-api/architecture/) — The templateconnector-api package owns external-system operations and source mappings. The shared connector SDK owns reusable runtime contracts.
